email.subject: POAP KINGS (#J2RGCRVG) — war-focused, culture-rich clan (2000+ trophies)
email.body:
Hey!

POAP KINGS is recruiting players at 2000+ trophies who want a clan that’s organized, competitive in Clan Wars, and actually fun to be part of.

Quick snapshot:
- Clan: POAP KINGS (#J2RGCRVG)
- Members: 22
- Combined trophies: 165,633
- Avg member level: 42.5
- Weekly donations: 44
- Clan War trophies: 140

What makes us different:
- We’re war-minded without being toxic. We push participation and wins, but real life comes first.
- We run clan traditions: POAPs (Proof of Attendance / Proof of Arena Push) to mark seasons + milestones.
- We have a Free Pass Royale tradition: top war performer (War Champ) earns a Pass Royale reward (criteria can vary by season, but it stays rare and meaningful).
- Builder energy: we track milestones and clan memory with our own systems (yes, the clan even has “Elixir” helping us stay organized).

Who you’ll be running with (real standouts):
- raquaza (Co-Leader) — 12,286 trophies. War leader energy.
- King Levy (Co-Leader) — 11,532 trophies. War-focused, competitive.
- King Thing (Leader) — 10,317 trophies. Known for Royal Ghost + Witch.
- JaxikoLane (Elder) — 8,892 trophies. Known for Goblin Barrel pressure and leads current donations (18).
- Ditaka — 8,321 trophies. Also leading donations (18).

What we’re looking for:
- Players who like Clan Wars and will use their war decks when they can.
- People who donate and help others level.
- Chill competitors who want to build something with a real identity.

If that’s you, come take a look and hop in:
https://poapkings.com

See you in the river race,
POAP KINGS
